release_notes_residuals: an unpaired '<!--' inside a display code fence above the gates block false-refuses (comment spans are computed on raw text); fail-safe, avoid unpaired comment markers above the fence

non-plain fence forms (~~~gates, ```GATES, ````gates, 1-3 space indent) render as fences to a human but refuse by design: the plain unindented lowercase ```gates is the one form renderer and parser read identically

declared composition checks internal receipt consistency, not provenance: a runner that forges the over/excluding fields, or declares nothing, is not caught -- the residual is the adversary who reads the prereg (D3, disclosed in the prereg itself)
